_help: Controls which pickaxe can break which blocks in which dimension.
pickaxe_tiers: tier number -> items (or #tags). A higher tier can break everything a lower tier can.
dimensions: dimension id -> rule. A rule applies to `blocks` (ids or #tags) at or above `min_y`.
min_tier: lowest pickaxe tier allowed to break those blocks there.
min_y:    optional. Blocks below this height are not restricted (speeds up the check).
Dimensions that are not listed have no restrictions.
Non-player breaking (explosions, other mods) of listed blocks is always blocked.
Reload in game with /aa debug reload_rules (requires OP to prevent spam)
New players will already recieve the update when they join the server through packets
This allows server owners to customise their experience if they wish.
